purpose: Proposed end-to-end bounded conditional envelope with separate locked calibration, screen and fresh confirmation gates; not authorized by this document.
dependencies: Authoritative full TinyStories source receipt, revision and split content identities; published 32k tokenizer and prepared IDs or explicitly label exact reconstruction/adaptation
Native RX 7900 XTX registration; physical claim and private local lifecycle accepted by current host
AMD same-start precision and no-op checks; budget/device/disk can accommodate charged setup, evaluator and both paths

quote.hard_stop: Any cap, nonfinite output or state, input/claim mismatch, or mandatory setup exceeding envelope; do not substitute reduced batch/horizon

hardware_reference_only.rocm_qualifier: 4k/tied/4096 labels per update, not an estimate for this recipe

measurement.design: Charge initial and terminal validation, checkpoint, auth/probes, warmup and preparation; first 8 startup, 4 timing blocks of 8 thereafter. Record full-phase wall and native update-only wall independently, effective W and backbone hashes and step-1 actual deltas. No treatment CE unblinding to select threshold or practical effect.
measurement.backend: Uncompiled common supported BF16 AMD setting, SDPA if validated at shape. Existing XPU-only compiled head cannot be assumed compatible. Fix the same output chunking for both before timing; any required loss-path change is a disclosed backend adaptation.
measurement.checkpoint_retention: Current recovery and final matched states; per-arm resource inventory + verified consumer checks. No pruning unique data without owner approval.

future_research_separately_gated.condition_time_quote: Q_i(T)=ceil_to_300s(1.25 * (setup/startup_i+T*t_i+n_eval*eval_i+n_save*save_i+charged_probes_i)), nonoverlapping phases. t_i=max(p90 post-startup update time, slowest post-startup block mean).
future_research_separately_gated.budget: Reserve 3*(Q0+Q4) fresh confirmation plus 5% recovery before 1*(Q0+Q4) screen; add calibration and separate baseline-repeat cost to set practical effect before treatment inspection. Each permission must include a real numeric cumulative wall and deadline, not just formula; decline if no headroom.
future_research_separately_gated.calibration_limitations: 40 updates wholly in warmup. No trained effect, power or hit-time inference. Freeze T after calibration; 512 is only a pilot, 2961 needed for one-published-pass horizon.

alternative.dimensions: V4096, untied, width128, 2 layers, context128, batch16
alternative.resource_quote: 8 CPU threads, 8 GiB RAM, 4 GiB new run output, up to 20 minutes per arm + 5 cleanup; quote, not local measured completion guarantee. Prepare and validate the exact reference 20k/500 splits and tokenizer before running. Requote on failure. No inference about historical 32k AMD recipe.

acquisition.provider: Hugging Face public dataset roneneldan/TinyStories revision f54c09fd23315a6f9c86f9dc80f725de7d8f9c64, four train and one validation parquet, license CDLA-Sharing-1.0
acquisition.rebuild: Use canonical current source.yaml to create a NEW source lock, verify file sizes and LFS hashes against same revision, exclude old 500k sampling declaration. Verify cleaned train=1792647 / validation=21990; tokenizer SHA256 2bd4d6d8a7039aa94ba8ef1508d8816beef0a121d902f8fd5e15cd9029b27de4 and origin manifest 9936c81483e203dc6e25448c09cf97b7391e61fc910f471ed8687d9c22d5a2b7; independently verify prepared train 388198157 / dev 4647305 token counts and pin resulting digests. Counts alone do not prove equality; seek original prepared digests if absent, label as an exact-settings authenticated reconstruction, not byte-for-byte replication.

caps.stage_specific_deadline: Stamp real UTC start and hard deadline in native job before first launch. No presumed reservation. If an intervening claim is in use, no interference; overall deadline does not extend.
caps.retry_limit: No additional efficacy training invocations or budget refresh; one pre-GPU mechanical retry only if under all original caps. No scientific retries because unfavorable.

baseline_only_precision.condition: C0 twice, seed 13, same inputs, no treatment inspection to set practical effect; for endpoint jitter, not cross-seed variance. Historical between-seed evidence separate.

runs_at_selected_horizon.resource_gate: After 2x40 calibration actually measure Q0,Q4. Reserve 3(Q0+Q4) for 6 fresh confirmation arms, 2Q0 for precision, 1(Q0+Q4) for screen and 0.9h for recovery/cleanup before any treatment screen. Include 25% margin, phase costs, prior used time, and every run. All reservations together plus calibration must fit 18h; each efficacy arm <=2h and disk must fit finals and transient generations. Use 2961 if it fits, else only an explicitly accepted 512-update post-warmup pilot; otherwise report new quote/stop. No other horizon/update/batch changes.
runs_at_selected_horizon.budget_arithmetic: 18h - 45m - 54m = 58,860 s available. Ten 512-update arms require 671,088,640 labels; 11,401 end-to-end labels/s accrued across arms before extra time margin, 14,252/s before 25% quote padding even if overhead were nil. If exact-shape observations miss the budget, stop before screen. These are necessary throughput gates, not predicted speeds.

proposed_combined_authorization.storage_basis: Measured local free space ~805.2 decimal GB on WSL root after qualifier; protected older runs and qualifying environment remain untouched. Public study reported ~1.6 GB prepared data per 32k arm plus two checkpoints. Keep at most two routine rolling generations and final states per declared comparison; native preflight must fit 64 GiB incremental allowance without reliance on permanently deleting unique state. No corpus/weights upload or purchase.
